## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope matches the linked issue; commits are small and Conventional Commits.
- [ ] Every commit references the issue in its message (for example, Refs #123).
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md describes the actual change and links the issue.
- [ ] Documentation matches tested behavior; no secrets or private data are included.
